## Purpose
The setup form for a deployment package. Its sections are Worker, third-party credentials used by the tool code, Connectors and Databases. A field left blank is filled from the vault.

## Responsibilities
- `DeploySetupForm({manifest, state, onChange})` with `Field` rows, radio groups (for example the SQL database mode) and switches.
